tag.description:
##### Endpoints for content data. This category includes 4 endpoints:
- [/v1/content/latest](/pro-api-reference/content#content-latest) - Content Latest
- [/v1/content/posts/top](/pro-api-reference/content#content-top-posts) - Content Top Posts
- [/v1/content/posts/latest](/pro-api-reference/content#content-latest-posts) - Content Latest Posts
- [/v1/content/posts/comments](/pro-api-reference/content#content-post-comments) - Content Post Comments

operations.description:
Returns a paginated list of content pulled from CMC News/Headlines and Alexandria articles.

  
  **This endpoint is available on the following [API plans](https://coinmarketcap.com/api/pricing/):**
  - Standard
  - Professional
  - Enterprise

**Cache / Update frequency:** Five Minutes
**Plan credit use:** 0 credit

parameters.name: X-CMC_PRO_API_KEY
parameters.description: Your CoinMarketCap Pro API key

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Optionally offset the start (1-based index) of the paginated list of items to return.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optionally specify the number of results to return. Use this parameter and the "start" parameter to determine your own pagination size.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Optionally pass a comma-separated list of CoinMarketCap cryptocurrency IDs. Example: "1,1027"

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Optionally pass a comma-separated list of cryptocurrency slugs. Example: "bitcoin,ethereum"

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Optionally pass a comma-separated list of cryptocurrency symbols. Example: "BTC,ETH". Optionally pass "id" *or* "slug" *or* "symbol" is required for this request.

parameters.name: news_type
parameters.description: Optionally specify a comma-separated list of supplemental data fields: `news`, `community`, or `alexandria` to filter news sources. Pass `all` or leave it blank to include all news types.

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description: Optionally specify a comma-separated list of supplemental data fields: `news`, `video`, or `audio` to filter news's content. Pass `all` or leave it blank to include all content types.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optionally pass a comma-separated list of categories. Example: "GameFi,NFT".

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Optionally pass a language code. Example: "en". If not specified the default value is "en".
